opennyai_summary.facts:
By this petition filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the petitioner, namely, Monimul Hoque, has prayed for granting pre-arrest bail, apprehending arrest in connection with Chhaygaon P.S. Case No. 134/2024 under Section 120(B)/342/376(3)/506 IPC r/w Section 6/17 of POCSO Act, 2012.
3.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is a student of Gate Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Talengana and he regularly attended the class since 2022 to 2023.
It is also submitted that the petitioner is no way involved in the alleged offence as stated in the FIR.
However, the learned counsel for the informant prays for DNA test of the petitioner to prove the paternity of the child, but the petitioner has no objection to conduct the DNA test.
Considering the background of the case, the previlege of pre-arrest bail may be extended to the petitioner.
In support of his submissions, the learned counsel for the petitioner has placed reliance on a following case law- (i) Jayanta Chatterjee vs. The State of West Bengal, in Criminal Appeal No.
537/2020.
5. Mr. Hussain, learned counsel for the respondent No. 2 submits that though he has objection in granting bail to the petitioner.
However, interim protection may be granted to facilitate the DNA test after birth of the child of the victim.
It is also submitted that as per medical report, tentative date of delivery is 28.08.2024.
6.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, this Court finds that the petitioner, above-named, is granted the interim protection till completion of DNA test.
8. Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the petitioner, named above, in connection with Chhaygaon P.S. Case No. 134/2024 under Section 120(B)/342/376(3)/506 IPC r/w Section 6/17 of POCSO Act, 2012, he shall be released on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.
9. The direction for pre-arrest bail is subject to the conditions that the petitioner:
(a) shall appear before the Investigating Police Officer within ten days from today and shall co-operate with the investigation;
(b) shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or Page No.# 4/4 promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
